summary: OVR-000403 pins four commits as evidence that belong to the concurrent paper workstream, not to this revision.
why: The entry's commit references were collected as every commit since the session's base, in a working tree a second session was writing to. Four of the fourteen, e6aa68f, ba209e1, 2c579bc and 90dea96, are the paper thread's run-09 harness and journal and touch none of the eleven documents the revision pins. A reader following them would find work this revision did not do, which is a false claim in a governance record even though the pinned digests are correct. The eleven documents and their before and after digests stand and are re-recorded by the replacement, whose references name only the ten commits of this revision.
